points.description: States that the DecideAction state/node decides the robot's next turning direction/action (which way the bot should turn or move next).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it makes a decision or controls movement without mentioning turning/direction.

points.description: Mentions the possible choices (left, right, or U-turn) and that the decision depends on the robot's current state/situation.
points.partial_credit: Half if only some options are named (e.g. left/right only) or the dependence on robot state is missing.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says DecideAction picks the bot's next turn (left, right or U-turn) based on the robot's state. Part marks: a vague decision/direction idea, or only some turn options named, or state dependence missing. No marks for unrelated purposes (e.g. sensing, stopping only, or motor control with no decision about direction).
